evaluation.note: Pilot estimates from one wearer; the test interval is wide.

input.interpolation: numpy.interp: slope=(y1-y0)/(t1-t0), y=slope*(t-t0)+y0 in float64, stored as float32
input.timestamps: seconds, strictly increasing; repeated or backward samples are dropped

model.split_rule: go left when float64(feature) <= threshold; NaN goes left when missing_left
model.summation: logit = baseline + tree values summed in tree order

provenance.selection_rule: highest development out-of-fold AUC-PR, prior excluded

status_note: Exported for on-device parity and shadow testing; not promoted. Physical AirPods evidence is required before it drives Live by default.
